```{r}
#| echo: false
#| message: false
#| warning: false
library(yaml); library(glue)

find_data <- function(f) {
  p <- file.path("_data", f); if (file.exists(p)) return(p)
  p2 <- file.path("..", "_data", f); if (file.exists(p2)) return(p2)
  stop(paste("Cannot find", f))
}

pubs <- yaml::read_yaml(find_data("publications.yml"))

render_tags <- function(tags) {
  if (is.null(tags)) return("")
  spans <- paste0('<span class="dc-tag">', tags, '</span>', collapse=" ")
  paste0('<div class="dc-tag-row" style="margin-top:0.6rem;">', spans, '</div>')
}

render_pub <- function(p) {
  doi  <- if (!is.null(p$doi)) glue('<a class="dc-pub-link" href="https://doi.org/{p$doi}" target="_blank">DOI &rarr;</a>') else ""
  pdf  <- if (!is.null(p$pdf)) glue('<a class="dc-pub-link" href="{p$pdf}" target="_blank">&darr; PDF</a>') else ""
  abst <- if (!is.null(p$abstract)) glue('<p class="dc-pub-abstract">{p$abstract}</p>') else ""
  auth <- gsub("\\*\\*(.*?)\\*\\*", "<strong>\\1</strong>", p$authors)
  glue('
<div class="dc-pub">
  <div class="dc-pub-year">{p$year}</div>
  <div>
  <div class="dc-pub-title">{p$title}</div>
  <div class="dc-pub-authors">{auth}</div>
  <div class="dc-pub-venue">{p$journal}</div>
  {abst}
  {render_tags(p$tags)}
  <div class="dc-pub-links">{doi}{pdf}</div>
  </div>
</div>')
}

render_section <- function(items, label, num) {
  if (is.null(items) || length(items)==0) return(invisible(NULL))
  cat(glue('\n\n## {label}\n\n'))
  cat(glue('<div class="dc-divider"><span class="dc-divider-label">{num} — {label}</span><div class="dc-divider-line"></div></div>\n'))
  items <- items[order(sapply(items, function(p) p$year), decreasing=TRUE)]
  for (p in items) cat(render_pub(p), "\n")
}
```

render_section(pubs$conference,       "Conference Papers",        "03")
render_section(pubs$reports,          "Reports & Other Outputs", "04")
